title: DEC-001: Card data never stored on the device
outcome: The mobile app never stores card numbers or CVV on the device. Checkout uses the payment provider's hosted tokenization and keeps only the token.
donot: store card number, card cache, cache card details, save card on device, store CVV
instead: Use hosted tokenization and keep only the payment token.
why: Keeping card data off the device keeps the app out of the card-data compliance scope and removes a high-impact leak path.

title: DEC-002: First-party analytics only
outcome: Product analytics go through our own event collector. No third-party analytics or session replay SDKs ship in the app.
donot: third-party analytics SDK, analytics SDK, session replay, heatmap SDK
instead: Send events to the internal event collector (schema in the Events catalog).
why: Users were promised that behavioural data stays with us. Third-party SDKs also added 4 MB to the app bundle.

title: DEC-003: Minimum OS versions are iOS 16 and Android 10
outcome: New releases support iOS 16 or later and Android 10 or later. Older versions only receive the last compatible build.
applies: minimum OS, legacy devices, iOS 15, Android 9, OS support
donot: support iOS 15, support Android 9, lower the minimum OS
instead: Point customers on older devices to the last compatible build.
why: Testing matrix cost; less than 3 percent of active users were on older versions when this was decided.

title: DEC-004: Passwordless sign-in, no SMS codes
outcome: Sign-in uses email magic links and passkeys. We do not add SMS one-time codes as a primary or fallback method.
applies: login, sign in, sign-in, authentication, one-time code, verification code, OTP
donot: SMS OTP, SMS code, SMS verification, text message code
instead: Improve magic-link delivery or offer a passkey prompt.
why: SIM-swap risk and per-message cost. Support tickets showed email delay is the real pain, not the method.

title: DEC-005: Every new feature ships behind a remote flag
outcome: New user-facing features are released behind remote feature flags with a kill switch. Hardcoded or build-time toggles are not used for releases.
applies: feature flag, rollout, roll out, release, launch
donot: hardcoded toggle, build-time flag, hardcoded flag
instead: Create a remote flag with a kill switch before the first merge.
why: Two incidents in Q2 needed an app-store release to turn a feature off.

title: DEC-006: Offline mode is read-only
outcome: Offline mode only shows cached content. No writes are accepted while offline.
instead: Show a read-only banner while offline.
why: Conflict resolution was not designed yet.

title: DEC-007: Offline drafts for notes only
outcome: While offline, users can create and edit note drafts, which sync on reconnect. Payments and checkout stay online-only.
donot: offline payment, offline checkout, offline purchase
instead: Queue note drafts locally and sync on reconnect; block checkout with a clear offline message.
why: Replaces DEC-006 after the sync conflict design was approved.
